diffs.diff: temperature_degC: datasheet reading gives 0.01 per count, the part's model has 0.0000177, -0.0001431
diffs.evidence: BMP388 datasheet BST-BMP388-DS001 rev 1.7, sec. 3.10: 'The data are read out in an unsigned 24-bit format both for pressure and for temperature ... the actual pressure and temperature need to be calculated using the compensation parameters stored in the device' (sec. 3.11 / appendix 9.2: t_lin = (uncomp_temp - PAR_T1)*PAR_T2 + (uncomp_temp - PAR_T1)^2*PAR_T3, with PAR_T1 = NVM_PAR_T1/2^-8, PAR_T2 = NVM_PAR_T2/2^30, PAR_T3 = NVM_PAR_T3/2^48). There is no fixed 0.01 degC/count scale on the BMP388 (that is the BMP280/BME280 integer-output convention). The model's driver implements appendix 9.2 verbatim; its sim scale 1.7695e-5 degC/count and offset -122.3087 degC are exactly what appendix 9.2 gives for the sim's own calibration registers (0x31-0x32 = 0x6978 -> PAR_T1 = 6912000; 0x33-0x34 = 0x4A38 -> PAR_T2 = 1.7695129e-5; PAR_T3 = 0): -6912000*1.7695129e-5 = -122.3087.

diffs.diff: pressure_Pa: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has 0.0000177, -0.0001431
diffs.evidence: Same datasheet, sec. 3.10/3.11 and appendix 9.3: raw 24-bit uncomp_press must be compensated as P = PAR_P5 + PAR_P6*t + PAR_P7*t^2 + PAR_P8*t^3 + uncomp_press*(PAR_P1 + PAR_P2*t + PAR_P3*t^2 + PAR_P4*t^3) + uncomp_press^2*(PAR_P9 + PAR_P10*t) + uncomp_press^3*PAR_P11 (Pa), with PAR_P1 = (NVM_PAR_P1 - 2^14)/2^20, PAR_P5 = NVM_PAR_P5/2^-3 etc. There is no fixed 1 Pa/count scale (sec. 3.4 table: 21-bit resolution 0.085 Pa at x32 oversampling, before compensation). The model's driver implements appendix 9.3 verbatim; its sim pressure mapping (scale -0.00014305 hPa/count, offset 2000 hPa, control in hPa) is exactly what appendix 9.3 yields for the sim's calibration registers: NVM_PAR_P1 = 0x0568 -> (1384-16384)/2^20 = -0.014305 Pa/count = -0.00014305 hPa/count; NVM_PAR_P5 = 0x61A8 -> 25000*8 = 200000 Pa = 2000 hPa; all other coefficients 0. (The gate lists both model values for each quantity; -0.0001431 is the pressure scale, 0.0000177 the temperature scale.) check.ts PASSes with the sim test T=23.75C P=987.65hPa.
